name: CSS declaration text
def: Raw or parsed CSS style text, declaration lists, or declaration name/value pairs.

name: CSS property name
def: A single CSS property identifier.

name: DOM element
def: A DOM node or event target inspected for identity, containment or attributes.

name: HTTP request body
def: The incoming request body or stream on the demo server, or the reason it was refused.

name: unknown JSON value
def: A raw or parsed JSON value of unknown shape, to be checked or classified.

name: URL / link address
def: A URL, link, image source or query-string parameter.

name: action reference
def: A reference to a built-in or code action, its encoded form, or its parameters.

name: evaluation scope / context
def: The ambient renderer or evaluation context, a dotted path into it, or a scope fragment.

name: data key / answer path
def: A data key, storage name, row path or answer address identifying where an answer lives.

name: single answer value
def: One answer or literal value entered into, or read from, a field.

name: form answers record
def: The whole answers record, or answers for a repeated row, possibly with a tree to evaluate against.

name: prop value of unknown shape
def: A component prop value to be coerced, normalised or set.

name: property / attribute name
def: The name of a component property, attribute or parameter.

name: rectangle geometry
def: Measured element rectangles, bands or points for hit testing and layout.

name: pointer event / position
def: A pointer event or client coordinates, possibly with candidates to hit-test.

name: numeric value
def: A number or numeric input to parse, bound or clamp.

name: condition operand
def: One side of a comparison: an operand, its reference, kind or resolved readings.

name: condition tree
def: A condition, expression or visibility rule, possibly with its operator, scope or depth.

name: component node
def: A single component node or subtree, with optional parent, depth, scope or answers for traversal.

name: component node key
def: A node key or set of taken keys, used for lookup, selection or unique-key generation.

name: component tree / form document
def: A whole form document or component tree, optionally with a key or context to look up.

name: component type definition
def: A component type, kit, palette entry, schema or default props describing what a component is.

name: free text entry
def: Text typed, pasted or drafted by the user.

name: error / message text
def: An error, fault, helper or validation message to show or report.

name: event handler wiring
def: An event name, handler map or event wiring on a node.

name: validation rule
def: A validation rule, its bounds, guard, message or the value it checks.

name: regex pattern
def: A pattern source, optionally with the string to test against it.

name: drag and drop state
def: Drag source, drop slot, pending drag or reorder direction in the designer.

name: document store / persistence
def: Stored documents, store files, change callbacks and saved drafts.

name: edit history
def: Undo history state or a document transform applied through it.

name: language / locale
def: A language tag, language definition list or translation bundle.

name: label / help text
def: Component label, description or help text, optionally with its key.

name: choice option
def: An option or option list for a select, radio or similar choice field.

name: keyboard event
def: A keyboard event to interpret as a command.

name: no input / signal
def: No meaningful argument: a click, blur, scroll or resize signal, or no parameters.

name: designer pane size
def: Designer panel, canvas or pixel widths and pane sides.

name: tree edit operation
def: A tree plus key, target, parent, index or updater describing an immutable edit.

name: heading
def: A heading tag name or heading props.

name: image settings
def: Settings for a decorative image component.

name: grid layout
def: A grid component, column count or grid track template.

name: unhandled union tag
def: A discriminant value that should be unreachable, for exhaustiveness checks.

name: identifier / name
def: An identifier or saved name for a form, tab, kit, palette, preset or example.

name: untrusted document input
def: An imported, not-yet-validated document, condition or binding.

name: field data type
def: A field's data type, optionally with an answer to check against it.

name: designer shell ref
def: A designer API handle or shell element ref.

name: designer theme mode
def: The designer chrome theme mode.

name: server lifecycle
def: A server handle and its exit callback.

name: property binding
def: A binding of a component property to data or a condition.

name: render surface / zone
def: A rendering surface or zone, possibly with an element, key or resolver.
